notes.title: Dead In Your TrackZ News
notes.content:
Level Progress Glitch
We are aware of a glitch that has caused players to lose their level progress. We believe we have found the solution so this issue should not happen again. We apologize to those who were affected!


Future PlanZ!
On another note, we have big plans for the future of Dead In Your TrackZ! Including:

Seasonal Events (Halloween event, Winter event), with themed zombies, decorations, and exclusive themed skins that you can keep even after the event ends.

More perks and powerups in Onslaught Mode.

Unlockable decorations for your train.

More upgrades and attachments.

More levels and zombie types.



Thank you to everyone who has supported us so far!!

notes.title: Update Patch Notes 1.08
notes.content:
V1.08 Patch Notes:


Changes / Additions:

Added unlock conditions for the glove skins and pistol skins.

Added a familiar decoration in the back of the train.

notes.title: Update Patch Notes 1.07
notes.content:
V1.07 Patch Notes:


In this update, we added powerups that have a 2.5% chance to drop from zombies in Onslaught mode. So far, we've added Double Score, which doubles the score you earn for 20 seconds, and Boom, which creates a large explosion instantly.



We also updated the textures for the Jade and Gold weapon skins for the Pistol.


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614570/47e07eeb6b1a1acbee8779f800eb732966464696.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614570/5940cd0b355f8fb1c9c0aa02765f701a7f71aecc.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614570/533e598a378ec5fc9bdb8a9dcb169359612ac38a.png"][/carousel]
Bug Fixes:

Fixed more train health glitches.

Additions / Changes:

Completed the Jade and Gold weapon skins.

Double Score and Boom powerups for Onslaught mode.

notes.title: Update Patch Notes 1.06
notes.content:
V1.06 Patch Notes:


We are currently working on adding powerups to the roguelike mode! Most likely will be ready in the next update.



Bug Fixes:

Fixed multiple glitches around train health and train health upgrades not working.

Additions / Changes:

More work on Jade gun skin.

Added metal impact sfx when shooting the train doors.

notes.title: Update Patch Notes 1.05
notes.content:
V1.05 Patch Notes

Changes / Additions:
Pistol:

Added cosmetic pistol skins.

Sounds:

Added sounds for picking up and dropping shotgun shells.

Increased volume of "Boost Ready / Pull Horn" beeping.

Added sound for when the train horn drops down.

Train:

Train monitor now displays current score so players can see their score increasing throughout the level.

"Boost Ready / Pull Horn" now takes up the entire monitor screen, making it more noticeable.

Decreased speed that the speed dials slow down at the start of levels.


Bux Fixes:
Repairing the train now saves when returning to the main menu from Onslaught Mode.

Optimized shotgun code to help eliminate lag when firing.

notes.title: Hotfix Patch Notes 1.04
notes.content:
V1.04 Patch Notes

Bug Fixes:
Fixed glitch where fully auto pistol would continue shooting even if you weren't holding it.

Fixed shotgun becoming full auto after buying Full Auto perk (only pistol should be full auto)

Fixed issue where shotgun would use two bullets when equipping Double Damage perk.

Fixed glitch that increased pistol and shotgun size each time you dropped them in the back of the train.

Fixed Shotgun and Auto Turret not appearing after purchase in Onslaught Mode.

notes.title: Update Patch Notes 1.03
notes.content:
V1.03 Patch Notes

Onslaught Mode:
Onslaught difficulty level is now displayed on the map in the back of the train.

Added a base +5% for all score gained in Onslaught mode.

Tweaked perk menu to improve readability.

Perks:

Added new Score Gain perk:  Increases score earned by 35%. Cost: 4000

notes.title: Update Patch Notes 1.02
notes.content:
V1.02 Patch Notes:


We mostly focused on perks this update and we also added more Steam Achievements for the Onslaught mode!


Perk Changes:
Changes:

Increased max amount perks that can be equipped: 2 -> 3

Balancing:

Increased cost of Auto Repair perk: 2000 -> 4000

Decreased cost of Bullet Chance perk: 4000 -> 3000

Buffed Lower Boost perk: -5 Boost -> - 10 Boost

Additions:

Added Full Auto perk: Makes pistols fully automatic. Cost: 8000

Added No Recoil perk: Completely eliminates recoil. Cost: 6000

notes.title: Hotfix Patch Notes 1.01
notes.content:
V1.01 Patch Notes:Additions:
Added new inputs for pausing the game to increase compatibility with various VR controllers.
Bug Fixes:
Fixed issue where headshot streak would not reset if your shot hit nothing.

Fixed Riot Zombie's helmet bouncing around after being knocked off.

Fixed multiple sound effects not changing volume when adjusting the volume sliders.
